Players Committee card image of [[Kylo Ren's TIE Silencer]] (Virtual Set 10) as first published, with the original game text: “May add 1 pilot. Kylo deploys -3 aboard. While Kylo piloting, immune to attrition < 5 and, unless Leia here, once per battle may lose immunity to attrition to ‘spin’: add maneuver to power.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/kylorenstiesilencer.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/kylorenstiesilencer.gif] as added in commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
